chemistry.name: ADOX RA-4 2.5 litre kit
chemistry.nominal_process: 35 C, 45 seconds developer and bleachfix; manufacturer specifies developer 35 +/- 0.3 C. User explicitly chooses their previously tested temperature/time experiment instead.
chemistry.planning: 325 ml per bath / 102 x 208 mm whole cut = 30 whole prints rounded down. Do not add A and B capacities; every print passes both baths. Test strips count.
chemistry.storage: Manufacturer: opened concentrate within two months; working solution up to one month in completely filled tightly closed bottles. Open processor storage is not covered by this statement.
